glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 囗 (“sheet”) + 大 (“person”) – man on a mattress. Original form of 裀 (“mat; layered garment”) or 茵 (“mattress; cushion”). Alternatively, possibly an ideogrammic compound (會意) of a man wearing clothing.
senses: [yīn] (literary) to take advantage; to make use of a situation
